9c29f3f4.text:
The word BETRAYER is crudely scratched over the finely etched epitaph that reads:

Yuriv lies here.
Father, Husband, Paladin.
Let his children bear witness to the fact that his dedication to the Light was unquestionable.
He would never ask anything of them that he himself would not do.
9c29f3f4.title: Yuriv's Tombstone

10266|6e63d362.name: Ug'thok
10266|6e63d362.text: You learn quickly, that is not a bad thing. Just be sure to do the job right, as long as it takes to do so. Now, I fear I must send you to Snarl to learn more. Learn what he can teach, but do not listen to his angry words. He gets that way when Saru's daughters laugh at him.

10378|5d1f9ab4.name: Omusa Thunderhorn
10378|5d1f9ab4.text: Treat the wind rider well as it takes you to your destination.  May your ancestors watch over you $N.

10378|6bdb24d7.name: Omusa Thunderhorn
10378|6bdb24d7.text: Many are the paths of the Earth Mother.  Wherever you decide to travel, may she watch over you.

10378|8b4f80e7.name: Omusa Thunderhorn
10378|8b4f80e7.text: Though the Crossroads seems to be the center of activity in The Barrens, I prefer the quietude of Camp Taurajo.  Where shall I send you?

10880|dc8290dc.name: Warcaller Gorlach
10880|dc8290dc.text: Greetings and salutations, hero!  I have the latest news from both continents and points beyond for your consideration.

11044|386a9ec7.name: Doctor Martin Felben
11044|386a9ec7.text: Once, it is true, I was human. What might otherwise be a shortcoming works to our advantage, $N, for I know human weaknesses intimately.

11860|ae16ea2b.name: Maggran Earthbinder
11860|ae16ea2b.text: I am afraid that I am no longer gentle or humble. Age and countless battles have hardened my skin and soul. Perhaps that is why Cairne assigned me to Sun Rock Retreat... the gentle winds and warm sun does ease the pain.

1383|da72a588.name: Snarl
1383|da72a588.text: So you think you are good enough to learn from me? The great Snarl? You are no more than a lowly worm beneath my boot. However, taking on an underling might make me seem more appealing to Sumi and Tumi. Let's see what meager skills you possess.

14727|5457bc8c.name: Vehena
14727|5457bc8c.text:
Aye, you there!  If you want to earn the respect of the Darkspear, then you can start by donating valuable resources for those in need!  Textiles and bandages don't grow on trees, ya know.

Rather than cash in various cloth pieces you find adventuring, donate them!  Doing so will earn you the recognition of the Darkspear!

1499|9cb5b422.name: Magistrate Sevren
1499|9cb5b422.text: Ah, you there!  I have tasks to give, and I need not waste time explaining their crucial nature.  Listen close.

15350|44b49612.name: Horde Warbringer
15350|44b49612.text: War is upon us, $N.  It's time for every member of the Horde to answer the call and join the fight against the cowardly Alliance.

16227|c5ceacbe.name: Bragok
16227|c5ceacbe.text: Where would you like to fly to?

1937|19122c56.name: Apothecary Renferrel
1937|19122c56.text: The Dark Lady has put the challenge forth. Now it is up to the Royal Apothecary Society to develop a new plague. We shall bring Arthas and his wretched army to their knees.

1938|cd4928e4.name: Dalar Dawnweaver
1938|cd4928e4.text: The Kirin Tor did not heed my warnings! The Alliance is a sham. Arugal is a reckless fool.

1952|7327dd7a.name: High Executor Hadrec
1952|7327dd7a.text: Hello, $C.  If you're here, then you must know that Silverpine is saturated with our enemies.  To survive, the Forsaken must drive them back!

2055|288436fb.name: Master Apothecary Faranell
2055|288436fb.text: The Royal Apothecary Society shall heed The Dark Lady's call to uncover the New Plague and drive Arthas and his heathen Scourge Army from the world once and for all.

2121|bf7b697c.name: Shadow Priest Allister
2121|bf7b697c.text: Information... With our scouts and agents, we control the flow of information in Lordaeron. Scourge movements, their holdings, all underneath our watchful eyes...

2226|dd7de3ae.name: Karos Razok
2226|dd7de3ae.text: Greetings.  Our bats are well trained and fed.  You'll not find faster.

2425|7dca81fc.name: Varimathras
2425|7dca81fc.text:
Do not presume to speak to me as though you are my equal, $c. Sylvanas is my queen, and I will do as she bids.

If you do not show the proper respect, I assure you, we can find a more than suitable place for you in the Nether.

But there is no reason we cannot have words if you wish to aid the Dark Lady...

250686|3c4152a4.name: Tabitha Heartweaver
250686|3c4152a4.text: Praise to the Banshee Queen, it isn't often I have visitors out here.

263570|8ac1454b.name: Creeg Bothunk
263570|8ac1454b.text: Greetings, traveler! I am Creeg Bothunk, the main supplier for the Darkspear Raiders. As you improve your standing with the Darkspear Raiders, I will be able to provide a variety of goods that you can use inside Darkspear Islands. Should you find yourself in need of item repair, I also provide those services.

266484|e94c420f.name: Morbin Lightbane
266484|e94c420f.text:
We paladins must earn our place amongst our Forsaken kin each day, lest we be judged as fanatics like the Scarlet Crusade. The light is not simply a tool of our foes, but a conduit for our righteous fury! It is in our devotion to the Dark Lady and the love of our home that we may channel the light to bring justice to our enemies.

The Banshee Queen keeps a close eye on us. Let her. She will see that our resolve shall never waver. We are Forsaken!

271613|f87677dc.name: Unfinished Abomination
271613|f87677dc.text: <The body looks incomplete and appears to be awaiting a head.>

272526|bf500b92.name: Glix Xizzix
272526|bf500b92.text:
Yes, I am the renowned trader who magnanimously fed the uh, starving... children...? ...of the Undercity during the recent war with the Scourge. Yes, I am the visionary businessgob and logistical genius who single-handedly armed the resistance and allowed our Dark Lady to found her nation of smelly corpses... um, I mean, "Forsaken."

Yep, I'm him. Glix Xizzix. I'd be happy to sign an autograph. For a small fee, of course.

What am I doing here running a barbershop, you ask? Well I got one word for you, bub--diversification. You've got to keep your revenue streams diversified!

2934|2cd97b51.name: Keeper Bel'dugur
2934|2cd97b51.text: Knowledge is both tool and weapon to those with the will to use it.

3310|cc0cf280.name: Doras
3310|cc0cf280.text: You haven't lived until you've looked down on the world from the back of a wind rider.

3318|2f8d506f.name: Koma
3318|2f8d506f.text: Besides the Grunts outside, my brothers and I fought at the battle of Hyjal. Any who seek to steal from the bank must face us first.

3318|6b36598f.name: Koma
3318|6b36598f.text: I guarantee this bank's security with my own blood, is that good enough for you?

3320|2f8d506f.name: Soran
3320|2f8d506f.text: Besides the Grunts outside, my brothers and I fought at the battle of Hyjal. Any who seek to steal from the bank must face us first.

3320|6b36598f.name: Soran
3320|6b36598f.text: I guarantee this bank's security with my own blood, is that good enough for you?

3320|ae78a458.name: Soran
3320|ae78a458.text: Would you rather trust your goods with a goblin?

3338|e2ff6310.name: Sergra Darkthorn
3338|e2ff6310.text: The land, the water, and the sky are all as one. It is your eyes that deceive you with such separation. The Earthmother is all those things and more.

3353|08830bac.name: Grezz Ragefist
3353|08830bac.text: Through rigorous retraining I have had to break many students of all they had previously learned so that I might teach them anew.  The service I offer becomes increasingly difficult to perform each time it is done.  It is for that reason that it becomes increasingly expensive with each retraining.  Do you desire that I break you of the talents you have learned?

3353|640f312b.name: Grezz Ragefist
3353|640f312b.text: Are you here for training?  Or are you just here to waste a $c's time.

3373|1355f2b7.name: Arnok
3373|1355f2b7.text: I am an $r of medicine, $r. If you have come here to learn, I shall do my best to teach.

3387|da8a5dad.name: Jorn Skyseer
3387|da8a5dad.text: Although we call this land the Barrens, to one who knows where to look this place teems with life.

3389|5612724d.name: Regthar Deathgate
3389|5612724d.text: We have our duties, $c.  Duties to the Horde.

3390|eb12150e.name: Apothecary Helbrim
3390|eb12150e.text: The Barrens holds a wealth of substances for which we, the apothecaries or Lordaeron, may find use.

3391|8f749700.name: Gazlowe
3391|8f749700.text: Thrall paid me and my boys well for helping out with the construction of Orgrimmar, so I decided to set up a port here. We do most of our business through Booty Bay and Baron Revilgaz.

3429|4e7d06f7.name: Thork
3429|4e7d06f7.text:
Welcome to the Crossroads, $c. My name is Thork--I lead the defenses here in the name of the Warchief.

Please, feel free to make yourself at home. As long as you mind your business, no one should have any problem with you taking up some space.

There are many threats to our safety here. If you've already become familiar with the lay of the land, speak to the others here--perhaps they have tasks for you to do.

3430|0e16a4d2.name: Mangletooth
3430|0e16a4d2.text:
You! $R! Come here. <snort>

Time is short, and my end <snort> is near. Mangletooth shall win; you will see. <snort>

My capture can still aid <snort> my people. The Razormane tribe is more powerful than the Bristlebacks!

The Horde looks to find out who leads the raids on their people. You <snort> shall aid Mangletooth in return for the information only I know. Mangletooth can help you! <snort> But you must help Mangletooth.

3430|71e13f0e.name: Mangletooth
3430|71e13f0e.text:
My hatred is strong <snort>, but the time is right to tell you a tale, $r.

Long ago a battle took place between gods. Agamaggan, our great boar god, fell to the earth after being defeated in the War of the Ancients, his blood raining down and his bones torn asunder. <snort>

Great thorns reached up out of the earth where his blood touched the ground, and his skull adorns one of the caverns to the south.

3433|ac5dfa0b.name: Tatternack Steelforge
3433|ac5dfa0b.text:
The Warchief has instructed me to study all kinds of weapons and armor. He has sent me here to the hub of both the tauren and $r cultures in the Barrens to meet as many travelers as possible, and to learn about the cultures of the Barrens.

He feels there's something to be learned from even the most pathetic of cultures... like the quilboar or centaur.

3442|ef9d74c5.name: Sputtervalve
3442|ef9d74c5.text: Director Riddlevox put me in charge of the Union's shredder development program. Few months on the job and I'm already in hot water! I could use your help, $N!

3448|dcea3712.name: Tonga Runetotem
3448|dcea3712.text: The times we live in are as fickle as the shifting winds, $c.  It is important to remember what is true and lasting in this world, and to preserve that.  Everything else is a waste.

3453|48c11c0f.name: Wharfmaster Dizzywig
3453|48c11c0f.text: Something I can help you with, $N? There's a shipment I've got to see to otherwise.

3478|43e0a582.name: Traugh
3478|43e0a582.text: Tell me, do your feel prepared to face the challenge I have laid out for you? The spirits tell me that you will pass, but do you have faith in them or in yourself?

3483|aa3c8600.name: Jahan Hawkwing
3483|aa3c8600.text: The Barrens, with its hot sun and hostile denizens, is the perfect place to test your strength and fortitude.

3489|68d65f37.name: Zargh
3489|68d65f37.text: Have a look at my meats, friend.  You won't want to go out into the Barrens without a good stock of provisions.

3615|ddd7878b.name: Devrak
3615|ddd7878b.text: My wind riders are trained to fly quickly through the hot Barrens air.

3682|960c6ca2.name: Vrang Wildgore
3682|960c6ca2.text: Are you in need of a weapon, traveler? You'll not find a finer blade anywhere, I assure you.

3703|a0a64f07.name: Krulmoo Fullmoon
3703|a0a64f07.text: This blue leather does draw the eye, I know. You see, we have a great many eager recruits running around here, hunting and slaying with more enthusiasm than wisdom. One must take precautions.

3934|e013de07.name: Innkeeper Boorand Plainswind
3934|e013de07.text: As the wind on the plains, you are always welcome here.

4312|c5ceacbe.name: Tharm
4312|c5ceacbe.text: Where would you like to fly to?

4551|d37b59d0.name: Michael Garrett
4551|d37b59d0.text: How may I be of service?
4551|d37b59d0.title: I need a ride.

4593|08830bac.name: Christoph Walker
4593|08830bac.text: Through rigorous retraining I have had to break many students of all they had previously learned so that I might teach them anew.  The service I offer becomes increasingly difficult to perform each time it is done.  It is for that reason that it becomes increasingly expensive with each retraining.  Do you desire that I break you of the talents you have learned?

4593|ed01dd60.name: Christoph Walker
4593|ed01dd60.text: The $c's role is one of protection.  Just as we protect our compatriots in battle, we must also protect the interests of the Forsaken.

5941|c2467ddc.name: Lau'Tiki
5941|c2467ddc.text: I can teach you fishing skills.

6491|22357dc5.name: Spirit Healer
6491|22357dc5.text: It is not yet your time. I shall aid your journey back to the realm of the living... for a price.

6739|fde1fb79.name: Innkeeper Bates
6739|fde1fb79.text: Rest your weary bones for a spell.

6741|fde1fb79.name: Innkeeper Norman
6741|fde1fb79.text: Rest your weary bones for a spell.

6929|7161de72.name: Innkeeper Gryshka
6929|7161de72.text: If we are to make these new lands ours then we must have places to rest our battle weary bodies. Lay your axe by the fire and share the stories of your mighty battles.

7683|a4ef73af.name: Alessandro Luca
7683|a4ef73af.text: Welcome to Blue Moon Odds and Ends, $c.  If you have any questions, please let me know.

7731|7161de72.name: Innkeeper Jayka
7731|7161de72.text: If we are to make these new lands ours then we must have places to rest our battle weary bodies. Lay your axe by the fire and share the stories of your mighty battles.

9564|8d6952f8.name: Frezza
9564|8d6952f8.text: Of course there's no danger in everything catching flames and exploding like a huge helium bomb. This baby will get you to Undercity faster and safer than any boat, and the view is truly breathtaking. Speaking of breath, smoking is not allowed while on board the zeppelin, and fire spells are banned from being cast during the trip.

1093-progress.name: Ziz Fizziks
1093-progress.text: Did you find those plans? I'm eager to impress the new boss. Hopefully, once he's convinced of my loyalty--well, as much as he can be convinced... goblin's honor, you know?--he'll feel comfortable making use of my rather impressive genius.
1093-progress.title: Super Reaper 6000

1824-progress.name: Ruga Ragetotem
1824-progress.text: Do you have the antennae?  If so then give them to me quickly, for twitching antennae do not twitch forever...
1824-progress.title: Trial at the Field of Giants

423-progress.name: Dalar Dawnweaver
423-progress.text: I will need 6 Glutton Shackles and 3 Darksoul Shackles before I can assess the situation and devise a final solution for Arugal.  Now heed your bidding and slay Moonrage Gluttons and Moonrage Darksouls until you have what I need.
423-progress.title: Arugal's Folly

424-progress.name: Dalar Dawnweaver
424-progress.text: Has Grimson the Pale been slain?  Varimathras will not be pleased if we ignore his bidding.
424-progress.title: Arugal's Folly

425-progress.name: Rane Yorick
425-progress.text: Have you killed Ivar the Foul?  If you won't do it for me and my brother, then do it for the Forsaken.
425-progress.title: Ivar the Foul

5041-progress.name: Thork
5041-progress.text: How goes your search for the supplies, $N? I trust the quilboar fall under your strength easily.
5041-progress.title: Supplies for the Crossroads

5042-progress.name: Mangletooth
5042-progress.text:
I will need 4 blood shards if you wish Agamaggan's strength, $r.

Your foes will cower before your strength were you to be given this blessing. <snort>

The Razormane's greatest warriors are infused with such power!
5042-progress.title: Agamaggan's Strength

5043-progress.name: Mangletooth
5043-progress.text:
My tribes greatest scouts are said to be unrivaled in their accuracy, and no rogue <snort> could measure up to their quickness in battle.

Bring me 4 blood shards and I will make you even more agile than any quilboar born.
5043-progress.title: Agamaggan's Agility

5046-progress.name: Mangletooth
5046-progress.text:
All those who <snort> enter battle have need of protection. Their bones must be strong. Their skin tough. <snort> My tribe knows this as well, and to add to the natural protection our quills and hide give us, <snort> we often call upon Agamaggan to protect us from harm before we go to war.

Bring me 4 blood shards <snort> and I will grant you the same protection.
5046-progress.title: Razorhide

5052-progress.name: Mangletooth
5052-progress.text:
Our tribes flock to the thorny areas throughout the Barrens <snort> because they are holy places, but none as holy as Razorfen. Agamaggan's body makes up the entirety of the Razorfen, <snort> but the Downs are especially protected because the entrance is made from his great maw! <snort> It will swallow whole those not loyal to him, and spit out their bodies after he's chewed them up! <snort>

Agamaggan has left his body behind to protect us, and he gives of his spirit so we may protect him. <snort>
5052-progress.title: Blood Shards of Agamaggan

6284-progress.name: Maggran Earthbinder
6284-progress.text: Besseleth is a ruthless predator... I fear for those that travel Webwinder Path at night. It's then that she and her children prey upon innocent travelers. I myself fell prey to her two-foot fang of death, but luckily I was able to fend her off and get to safety. I would give anything to see that monster destroyed.
6284-progress.title: Arachnophobia

7833-progress.name: Vehena
7833-progress.text:
We are currently accepting donations for wool cloth.  A donation of sixty pieces of wool cloth will net you full recognition by the Darkspear Trolls for your generous actions.  Our stores are such on wool that we would only need sixty pieces from you total; we should be able to acquire enough from others in the realm to support our drive.

If you have the sixty pieces of wool cloth on you and are ready to donate them, I'm able to take them from you now.
7833-progress.title: A Donation of Wool

79096-complete.name: Owen Thadd
79096-complete.text:
Thank you, $N. Our knowledge expands through your efforts.

If you discover more magical works that might benefit the library, please bring them to me.
79096-complete.title: Ataeric: On Arcane Curiosities

79096-progress.name: Owen Thadd
79096-progress.text: Have you brought something to add to our collection?
79096-progress.title: Ataeric: On Arcane Curiosities

844-progress.name: Sergra Darkthorn
844-progress.text: Have you collected the plainstrider beaks?
844-progress.title: Plainstrider Menace

845-progress.name: Sergra Darkthorn
845-progress.text: How many zhevra have you slain?
845-progress.title: The Zhevra

850-progress.name: Regthar Deathgate
850-progress.text: Hello, $N.  Do you have Barak's Head for me?
850-progress.title: Kolkar Leaders

867-progress.name: Darsok Swiftdagger
867-progress.text: Cut up enough of them yet? Keep slicing and taking trophies. I want 8 Witchwing talons.
867-progress.title: Harpy Raiders

872-progress.name: Thork
872-progress.text:
Cut off the head of their leader, and chaos ensues, $N. Learn this lesson well. It will aid you in the future.

The boars will flounder without direction, and we will be able to take back the Barrens.
872-progress.title: The Disruption Ends

884-progress.name: Jorn Skyseer
884-progress.text: $N, there is a new power behind your eyes!  You have met with the mighty Owatanka, have you not?
884-progress.title: Owatanka

889-progress.name: Mangletooth
889-progress.text:
Bring Mangletooth 10 blood shards and I will bless you with great speed. You will run with zhevra and the wind will be jealous of you.

It will not last long, but it should be enough to help you travel throughout the Barrens.
889-progress.title: Spirit of the Wind

890-progress.name: Wharfmaster Dizzywig
890-progress.text: Wares to send on the next ship, $N?
890-progress.title: The Missing Shipment

892-progress.name: Gazlowe
892-progress.text: So, what did Dizzywig have to say?
892-progress.title: The Missing Shipment

895-progress.name: Gazlowe
895-progress.text: What's happening? Something I can help you with? Goods to ship, perhaps an engineering job?
895-progress.title: WANTED: Baron Longshore

901-progress.name: Unknown
901-progress.text: The console lights are dimmed and the gauges and dials all read at their zero positions, everything idling.
901-progress.title: Samophlange

903-progress.name: Sergra Darkthorn
903-progress.text: How goes your hunt, $N?  Have you found the prowlers?
903-progress.title: Prowlers of the Barrens

91921-progress.name: Quinn Yorick
91921-progress.text: You return! I was beginning to come to terms with devolving into a ghoul.
91921-progress.title: Return to Quinn (Again)

95495-progress.name: Walton
95495-progress.text: Greetings, $c. What brings you up to my property today?
95495-progress.title: The Hermit Tanner

95507-progress.name: Vrang Wildgore
95507-progress.text: <Vrang grunts at you as you approach.>
95507-progress.title: Vrang's Game

95621-progress.name: Walton
95621-progress.text:
The remnants of Daelin Proudmoore's fleet who still fly his banner are just as rotten and barbaric as the admiral himself was before he died.

I don't know why they are so far from Tiragarde, but it can't be good.
95621-progress.title: Trouble in the Valley
